e.summary_en: Morocco’s insurance and social welfare supervisor: quarterly sector statistics (T1/T2 2026 PDFs available), a joint report with the central bank and market authority, and an Innovation Insurtech newsletter
e.body:
**ACAPS（Autorité de Contrôle des Assurances et de la Prévoyance Sociale，摩洛哥保险与社会保障监管局）** 是**摩洛哥的保险与社会保障监管机构**。本条目与 [[ivass]]（意大利）同属本轮市场覆盖轴，补上**北非/马格里布**这一空白（实测池内埃及、摩洛哥、加纳等为 0）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：首页 89KB；**统计栏目 `/fr/statistiques` 82.5KB**（站点另设英文镜像 `/en/statistics`）；页面内实测到**分季度行业统计 PDF 可直接下载**——**`ACAPS_statistices_T2-2026_FR.pdf`（2026-09 上传目录、实测 200、380.7KB）** 与 **`ACAPS_statistics_T1-2026_FR.pdf`（2026-05 目录）**，并提供按**发布频率**筛选季度统计的入口。**出版物**另实测到 **ACAPS 通讯 n°15**、**《Innovation Insurtech》通讯 N2**、**RSF n°13（2025）**，以及 **ACAPS 与摩洛哥央行（Bank Al-Maghrib）、市场监管局（AMMC）联合发布的第 13 期报告**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上北非**——池内非洲侧此前只有合成数据（[[africa-synth-insurance-datasets]]）与本轮前的南非（[[fsca]]、[[assa]]）、肯尼亚（[[ira-kenya]]），**摩洛哥此前为零**；而摩洛哥是**法语区非洲保险与强制社会保障（AMO/RC 车险）**的主要市场。**② 数据可得性好**——**分季度行业统计以 PDF 直链提供**（本轮实测 T1/T2 2026 均可下载），且**T2-2026 的上传目录为 2026-09**，即**该期数据落在解冻窗口内**——这是「**市场覆盖轴也能命中窗口内容**」的一个例子（与「窗口轴已扫干」并不矛盾：**新市场里的常规发布同样落在窗口内**）。**③ 两个值得注意的非数据资产**——**《Innovation Insurtech》通讯**说明摩洛哥监管机构在**主动跟踪保险科技创新**（可与 [[irdai-ai-governance]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]]、[[governance-mcp]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]] 并读）；**与央行 + 市场监管局的联合报告**是**跨部门金融稳定**口径的现成样本（可对照 [[iais-icp]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[seddk]]、[[asf-romania]] 的多部门监管结构）。**④** 跨市场对照见 [[cmf-chile]]、[[ira-kenya]]、[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[philippines-insurance-commission]]；农业与气候风险侧可接 [[agrisky-ai]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① 内容以法语为主**（存在英文镜像，但**英文覆盖度未逐项核实**）；**②** 本次核实到**统计页存在与两份季度统计 PDF 的直链可下载（HTTP 200）**，**但未打开 PDF 正文**，因此**不能确认字段口径、单位与覆盖范围**；**③** 仅核实了**部分**统计目录（页面以筛选器组织），**更早期的期次未逐一验证**；**④** 本条目**不主张**该站提供精算工具或机器可读结构化数据集。**核实说明**：首页（89KB）、`/fr/statistiques`（82.5KB）、`ACAPS_statistices_T2-2026_FR.pdf`（380.7KB）均 HTTP 200 实测；通讯与联合报告链接在页面内实测可见；**未打开任何 PDF 正文**。
e.body_en:
**ACAPS (Autorité de Contrôle des Assurances et de la Prévoyance Sociale)** is **Morocco’s insurance and social welfare supervisor**. With [[ivass]] (Italy), this entry belongs to the current market-coverage axis and fills the **North Africa / Maghreb** gap (a measured search found Egypt, Morocco and Ghana at zero).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): homepage 89KB; the **statistics section `/fr/statistiques`** is 82.5KB (the site also offers an English mirror at `/en/statistics`); the page carries **directly downloadable quarterly sector statistics PDFs** — **`ACAPS_statistices_T2-2026_FR.pdf` (uploaded under a 2026-09 directory, measured 200, 380.7KB)** and **`ACAPS_statistics_T1-2026_FR.pdf` (2026-05 directory)** — plus a **publication-frequency filter** for the quarterly statistics. Under **publications**, the site also shows **ACAPS newsletter no. 15**, an **"Innovation Insurtech" newsletter N2**, **RSF no. 13 (2025)**, and the **13th edition of a joint report by ACAPS with Morocco’s central bank (Bank Al-Maghrib) and market authority (AMMC)**.

For RIAA: **① it adds North Africa** — the corpus’s African side previously held only synthetic data ([[africa-synth-insurance-datasets]]) plus, since earlier this round, South Africa ([[fsca]], [[assa]]) and Kenya ([[ira-kenya]]), while **Morocco was at zero**; and Morocco is the leading market in **francophone Africa for insurance and compulsory social protection (AMO, compulsory motor liability)**. **② Data availability is good** — **quarterly sector statistics come as direct PDF links** (T1 and T2 2026 were both measurable this round), and the **T2-2026 upload sits under a 2026-09 directory**, i.e. **that period’s data falls inside the thaw window** — an example of how **the market-coverage axis can also hit window content** (not in contradiction with "the window is swept dry": **new markets keep publishing on their own cadence, and some of that lands in the window**). **③ Two non-data assets worth noting** — the **"Innovation Insurtech" newsletter** shows the Moroccan supervisor **actively tracking insurance technology** (readable with [[irdai-ai-governance]], [[aae-ai-act-position]], [[governance-mcp]] and [[iso-42001-toolkit]]); and the **joint report with the central bank and the market authority** is a ready-made sample of **cross-agency financial stability** reporting (compare the multi-agency structures in [[iais-icp]], [[oecd-insurance-data]], [[seddk]] and [[asf-romania]]). **④** Cross-market comparisons: [[cmf-chile]], [[ira-kenya]], [[tii-taiwan-insurance]], [[mas-insurance-statistics]], [[irdai-market-statistics]], [[philippines-insurance-commission]]; on the agricultural and climate-risk side, [[agrisky-ai]], [[climate-conditioned-cat]], [[dfa-climate-datasets]] and [[parametric-insurance-demo]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① the content is mainly French** (an English mirror exists, but **its coverage was not verified item by item**); **②** this check verified **the statistics page and two directly downloadable quarterly PDFs (HTTP 200)** **but opened no PDF**, so **field definitions, units and coverage cannot be confirmed**; **③** only **part** of the statistics catalogue was verified (the page is organised by filters) and **earlier periods were not checked individually**; **④** this entry does **not** claim the site offers actuarial tools or machine-readable structured datasets. **Verification note**: the homepage (89KB), `/fr/statistiques` (82.5KB) and `ACAPS_statistices_T2-2026_FR.pdf` (380.7KB) were measured at HTTP 200; the newsletter and joint-report links were observed on the page; **no PDF body was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**ACAPS（Autorité de Contrôle des Assurances et de la Prévoyance Sociale，摩洛哥保險與社會保障監管局）** 是**摩洛哥的保險與社會保障監管機構**。本條目與 [[ivass]]（意大利）同屬市場覆蓋軸，補上**北非/馬格里布**空白。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 89KB；**統計欄目 `/fr/statistiques` 82.5KB**（另有英文鏡像 `/en/statistics`）；頁面內實測到**分季度行業統計 PDF 可直接下載**——**`ACAPS_statistices_T2-2026_FR.pdf`（2026-09 上傳目錄、實測 200、380.7KB）** 與 **`ACAPS_statistics_T1-2026_FR.pdf`（2026-05）**，並提供按**發布頻率**篩選入口。**出版物**另實測到 **ACAPS 通訊 n°15**、**《Innovation Insurtech》通訊 N2**、**RSF n°13（2025）**，以及 **ACAPS 與摩洛哥央行（Bank Al-Maghrib）、市場監管局（AMMC）聯合發布的第 13 期報告**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上北非**——池內非洲側此前只有合成數據（[[africa-synth-insurance-datasets]]）與南非（[[fsca]]、[[assa]]）、肯尼亞（[[ira-kenya]]），**摩洛哥此前為零**；摩洛哥是**法語區非洲保險與強制社會保障（AMO／車險）**的主要市場。**② 數據可得性好**——**分季度行業統計以 PDF 直鏈提供**（T1/T2 2026 均可下載），且 **T2-2026 上傳目錄為 2026-09**，即**該期數據落在解凍窗口內**——這是「**市場覆蓋軸也能命中窗口內容**」的例子。**③ 兩個非數據資產**——**《Innovation Insurtech》通訊**說明該監管機構在**主動跟蹤保險科技**；**與央行 + 市場監管局的聯合報告**是**跨部門金融穩定**口徑的現成樣本（可對照 [[iais-icp]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[seddk]]、[[asf-romania]]）。**④** 跨市場對照見 [[cmf-chile]]、[[ira-kenya]]、[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① 內容以法語為主**；**②** 本次核實到**統計頁與兩份季度統計 PDF 直鏈可下載（HTTP 200）**，**但未打開 PDF 正文**；**③** 僅核實**部分**統計目錄，**更早期期次未逐一驗證**；**④** 本條目**不主張**該站提供精算工具或機器可讀結構化數據集。**核實說明**：首頁、`/fr/statistiques`、`ACAPS_statistices_T2-2026_FR.pdf` 均 HTTP 200 實測；**未打開任何 PDF 正文**。
